还可以，但是玩起来有几个玩家不爽设计者觉得很coooool很hardcore的点 1、角色脚下没有格子，容易误判范围攻击的大小 2、默认角色大招第一段能在一格外触发，容易误导，导致全部连段挨不到敌人 3、牛群图纯纯恶心人，要不你第一个行动位别放牛群，要不我永远不选牛图 4、忍者就不说了，机制逼你换血打，行吧，像笛子、扔火药桶的这种纯恶心人的作者看能不能换换ai逻辑，不要范围攻击连发 5、放弃游戏你就直接结算，放弃不结算就跟单机搞加密一样，何意呀 6、有些文本像机翻，我确实有点看不懂 7、那个弹反机制作者能不能再思考思考，我要打弹反：一张弹反卡+3张反击，而且弹反卡一个是经常性的自动到攻击卡前面弹空气，你要不让弹反的插入功能由玩家自选，要不把弹反做成资源，不占手卡，要不我为什么不拼刀或者格挡呢，弹反也只有中断那张金卡能用 8、动画你在每次攻击时可以减减速嘛，要不然我都不知道哪张卡奏效没奏效 9、新手教程进附加回合减速特效太猛了，我都以为电脑死机了 好玩还是好玩，但是希望能多打磨打磨吧

我们野人真是太无敌辣👍全程压着小怪boss打，一般小怪都是两回合结束战斗，boss更是直接被我按到板边暴打🤗更是可以通过弃牌续杯🍻，别让我的钢铁鲨鱼打到👊要不然没你好果汁吃💪武器防具一直给你上虚弱卷刃，让你尝尝什么叫肌无力😆你们行不行啊，到底连我二命都打不出来🤣 我们樵夫也是那个强无敌啊👍疯狂烧柴蓄力嘎嘎往上叠💪小怪邦邦两下就给你打趴👊和我对招？😠让你吃不了兜着走👇 这游戏注重的还是构筑，不要迷信高品质装备，适合自己构筑的装备才是最好的，就是白色和蓝色的装备也能用到通关，比如野人的卷刃刀。感觉忍者真是有些幽默了，输出不行，对招也打不过，叠闪还没有消耗来得快，以前以为用镣铐战士叠最厚的盾打反击才是最强的，结果碰到狗屎站桩乐师就老实了。直到玩了樵夫和野人我才明白，最好的防守就是进攻，让我拿到最强输出单卡鲨鱼你们就等死吧。 要说这游戏的缺点，还是内容太少只有三个boss，加载给人的感觉不流畅（可能是个人电脑配置问题），卡槽显示不交战敌人还是能打到你，这个比较恶心，有些装备提供的buff和debuff不显示说明，只能实践后在状态栏里看，比如各魔法元素的效果，还有又要提到卷刃了，如果不是我特意看都不知道是-1攻击，还有些buff层数意义不明，比如虚弱，我一回合就能给敌人上个十几层，但是虚弱只固定减攻25%，我只能猜测层数是有效回合数了。有些影响游玩体验，但不至于差到给差评。一般EA阶段的游戏都给不推荐，因为我不知道它能不能挺过EA阶段，但是官方在B站上还挺活跃，所以我对游戏能够出到正式版还是有信心的。

I thought upon first inspection that this game was more centered on the fighting(a game like YOMIH or Toribash), but after playing it, it is essentially just a card game, where you sometimes have to get closer to the enemy. I would rather play Slay the Spire at that point. You cant even see a replay of the fight after it has finished. The English translation is a bit scuffed and hard to understand at times. I wouldn't get the game at its current price and state.

[h1]战斗！爽！！！！！[/h1] 《符文竞技场》是一个拥有流畅战斗场面的卡牌策略决斗模拟游戏，游戏用卡牌竟然实现了竞技中的弹反，并且弹反效果在游戏动画中的展现力很强，打开游戏后根本停不下来，就想一直刷刷刷；游戏具有很强的策略性，随机性都在可控范围之中，是一款非常重操作的肉鸽卡牌策略模拟游戏！ [h3]超爽的三合一玩法[/h3] 游戏融入了肉鸽、传统卡牌构筑、模拟战斗场景三种元素的玩法，虽然元素很多，但是游戏绝对不是低劣的缝合怪，三种游戏元素相互互补，达到了一种微妙的平衡，在游戏中对卡牌进行选择后，在上方的战斗场景中会有很好的重现，技能对撞时候的弹反防御使人眼前一亮！ [h3]丰富的角色系统[/h3] 角色选择有很多，之后还会继续更新，角色可以穿戴装备（除属性加成外还有许多buff），角色穿戴上装备后，其在竞技场里面的形象也会随着改变，装备可以在铁匠铺进行分解升级，以面对更难的怪物；装备铁锭如果能合成更高品质的就好了，我常常会看着满仓库的白色装备无所适从。另外还有铭刻系统，类似《杀戮尖塔》中的遗物，可以增加角色的属性，同时角色还可以持有道具，这些道具可以在游戏过程中的商店进行选择。 [h3]与角色系统相辅相成的卡牌系统[/h3] 角色本身会有其基本的卡牌和被动效果，其内容极为丰富，不同的角色运用卡牌都会有不同的效果，另外，技能卡的演出效果是真的很赞，但是千万不要用大招去弹反轻击喔！ 卡牌种类比较丰富，可操作性较高，预判系统不仅是只预判到接下来的攻击防御，还有前摇等多种可以应变出招的占位卡牌，卡牌效果做的很不错，没有特别超模的卡牌，也没有太弱的卡牌，平衡性做的很不错。 [h3]真实的音效[/h3] 游戏中的音效做的很不错，打击的时候不同材质会有不同的声音，配合游戏精彩的模拟战斗演出，代入感更强了！ 总体来说，《符文竞技场》是一款非常不错的肉鸽卡牌策略决斗模拟游戏，其三合一的玩法使得其比其它肉鸽卡牌游戏更加有带入感，就是在一入坑的时候会感觉引导有些较弱，游戏现在有单独的新手引导模块，游玩时一定要过一遍引导；游戏本身素质很高，是一款非常不错的肉鸽卡牌模拟游戏！非常推荐！！！ [quote]关注&加入[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32969453/]大众点评[/url]，了解并体验更多好玩游戏[/quote]

The game's overall concept is pretty cool, Swords & Sandals mixed with Slay the Spire. Where it goes wrong though is the ♥♥♥♥♥♥ telegraphing of a move's range, the horrid card explanations, and the overall lack of balance. Some cards are literally worthless no matter the run/build and some cards are just so broken you'd be insane not to take them every run. Just take a look at the equipment you can find throughout the game, 90% is comically useless. Every single early-game I find myself using the Thief's armor & helmet because early on, there's nothing that even comes close! Even many of the late-game armors often fall short to max-upgraded thief armor. The game eventually becomes this slog of finding the few broken builds that basically allow you to kill the final boss in one rotation, and disregarding every other weapon, armor, and card. To me it doesn't seem like there's any room for innovation, especially on the later ascension levels. It's in early access, so hopefully the game is subject to change. But for now, I can only give it a 5/10 and cannot recommend it.

Cool game, innovative, refreshing and fun. You are a gladiator that builds combat deck and collect equipment and all revolves around battles where you prepare your moves ahead and then let it duel. The good stuff: - tactical battles with positioning and timing being the key - stuff to unlock, but not necessary to beat the game - multiple characters with different play styles and for each play style you can use different approach - simple but nice graphics, simple and effective UI The bad stuff: - bad english translations (some card description are hard to understand, some are missing entirely) - hard time to understand the mechanics (partly because of the terrible english, partly because the tutorial explains only the very basics) - the timing which is essential in this game is not properly and clearly displayed and often the timing aspec of specific card is missing entirely in the card description - even after 10 hours I still sometimes dont pick a card during selection because I dont understand what it could do - game content could be richer Summary: Without the "bad stuff" this game would be absolutely awesome. But devs seem to hear out these complains, they already released update to english translation recently and they promised to release another after acknowledging the above described concerns (especially the missing timing descriptions). Btw I would recommend this game even if it stays like this.

The concept is great fresh take on the deckbuilding genre, you have to play your cards and avoid your enemy attacks by using the enemies telegraphed moves on their timeline. That Darkest Dungeon heavy lined, shaded and darkish style is always a hit for me as well. But with that said its very very rough. Biggest issue is that the translation is pretty bad and the tutorial is not great either at giving an actual explanation on how things work. Yes, there is some in depth codexs available, but I shouldn't need to go digging in their for basic mechanics of how things like dodges work, or why the damage numbers of attacks fluctuate so much. The UI in battle is just ok, I think believe your energy total should be more prominent as its current location alllows it to be lost do to its small size. The out of battle menus and buttons are terrible at telegraphing what you are selected, even just highlighting the button would make it better. Post game when spending your meta currency there is no tooltips on anything, so you have no idea what you are trying to unlock.... I also wish there was a reset turn option, even if it had limited charges per run/battle. I play a lot of deckbuilders and I am use to committing to what I played but when you have a game that is based off getting your timeline right its annoying when you have wasted an energy accidently or in a prep that isnt working out like you thought it would. Performance is steady except on loading it likes to hitch up for a few seconds on any new screen or when clicking buttons out of battle. Its just enough to notice its not smooth but not enough to not want to play. In its current build(7/5/25) its fine if you can look past the translation and learning issues, it is something I will continue to play here and there but for the most these are probably big issues til fixed.

Rune Coliseum offers a compelling side-view arena experience where visual flair meets deep tactical planning. The core engagement lies in its turn-based combo system, which challenges players to carefully sequence attack, defense, and movement actions into a cohesive strategy. The progression loops and health management inherent to its roguelike structure provide a solid sense of growth. However, the experience is slightly dampened by translation inconsistencies and a lack of clear guidance on specific status effects. With refined UI/UX clarity and localization, its innovative combat mechanics could truly shine.

There's a reason why recent reviews are mostly negative. The update on 7/19/2026 completely changed how the game plays. It was a dynamic roguelite deckbuilder with interesting unlocks, now it's a confusing card battle management sim. The original game's metaprogression permanently unlocked unique heroes with fun gear builds, and runs provided varied upgrades building up to challenging boss fights. In the new game you buy disposable slaves (that die or retire), give them disposable gear (that breaks via durability), manage them via numerous unlockable buildings, guide them through confusing combat, give them inconsequential upgrades between fights, and emerge with unpredictable rewards, all while time passes and seasons change. And none of it is clearly explained. The worst part is the old game was solid and easy enough to understand despite needing some polish. But now gladiators and gear and runs have been downgraded while a questionable management layer has been added, accompanied by a rough, unhelpful UI. 8.5 months passed without game updates before this latest release, and I'm pretty bummed about how things turned out.
